verdict.rationale: The SOS's own entity search lets users get PDFs of many entity filings (docs-5). It also documents mechanisms for moving an entity out of state, such as continuation and domestication (docs-7). That is a thin, per-document form of export rather than a full data takeout, and probes found no API or machine-readable export surface. missing for 10: bulk export of all account/entity data, structured machine-readable formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), coverage of all filings rather than 'many', documented account-closure/data-exit process, independent corroboration.
